decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The use hereby permitted shall be discontinued and the premises restored to their former condition on or before the 14 August 2012 in accordance with a scheme of work submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The office floor space (B1) contained within this proposal hereby approved shall be used only as offices ancillary to the marketing suite and associated company usage and shall not be used for any other purpose.
description: Use of ground floor of the west wing for 3 show flats, B1 offices with ancillary areas,  use of the gallery and film liaison unit as a marketing suite, all for a temporary period of two years
